WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS control_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND r.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS per_day, c.control_net, ss.net_sales - c.control_net AS gap
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN ctrl c ON c.store_id = ss.store_id
ORDER BY rank

WITH nl AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS d, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=116 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=116 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.d, ROUND(SUM(n.v),2) AS mine, MAX(c.net_sales) AS ctrl, ROUND(SUM(n.v)-MAX(c.net_sales),2) AS gap
FROM nl n LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales c ON c.business_date=n.d AND c.store_id=116
WHERE n.d BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines, min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=116 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) AS n FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT s.store_id, min(f.sale_date) AS first_date, max(f.sale_date) AS last_date, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dup_keys, count(*) AS rows_,
       min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=116 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-14' AND DATE '2025-09-16'
  AND (f.receipt_id, f.line_no) IN (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 12

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no ORDER BY f.sales_line_id) AS rn
    FROM fact_sales_line f
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE f.rn = 1 AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name,
       td.trading_days, ROUND(ss.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS net_sales_per_trading_day,
       ROUND(ss.net_sales - (SELECT SUM(r.net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r, params p WHERE r.store_id = ss.store_id AND r.business_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date), 2) AS gap_to_control
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
